data.name: Dheerendra
data.gender_notes: Dheerendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Dheerendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the Sanskrit words ‘dheera’ meaning fearless and ‘andra’ meaning man. This name is bestowed upon a child to instill courage and bravery in them. Dheerendra is a revered name in Hindu mythology, where it is believed to have been borne by several gods and rulers. The name Dheerendra carries the meaning “Fearless, Courageous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Dheerendra usually hope their child will grow to embody fearless, courageous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the courage and strength of a lion, Dheerendra inspires fearlessness and determination in the face of adversity.
data.etymology: Dheerendra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Fearless, Courageous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dheerendra total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

data.cultural_impact: The name Dheerendra holds significant cultural impact as it has been associated with bold and fearless leaders in Hindu mythology. Lord Indra, the king of heaven, is known as Dheerendra or Vavadhoota, symbolizing his fearlessness and strength. Historical figures like Chandragupta Maurya and Samudragupta, who ruled large kingdoms and expanded their territories, were also known by the name Dheerendra.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Dheerendra lies in its root word ‘dheera’, which means fearless. The name encourages the etching of courage and bravery in the child's character. The belief is that the child imbued with the name Dheerendra develops a strong will and determination, resilient against the challenges of the world. Dheerendra is also a reminder of the inner divinity we all carry, constantly inspiring one to display the courage and fearlessness within.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Dheerendra: The valiant one, steadfast and fearless in dharma, embodying deep inner courage and wisdom.

historical_references.reference: Dheerendra was a prominent Jain monk and philosopher during the Gupta Empire in the 5th century CE. He is known for his works on Jain philosophy and ethics, particularly the Tattvartha Sutra.

Another Dheerendra was a Chalukya king who ruled in the late 12th and early 13th centuries CE. He is known for his military conquests and the construction of several temples, including the famous Kailasa Temple in Ellora.
